about_the_game:
Warrior Guild

Embark on your rise from humble recruit to legendary dragon slayer.
Warrior Guild is a work-in-progress 3D action RPG focused on PvE combat, exploration, and progression in a sprawling fantasy world filled with danger, honor, and fire-breathing beasts.

⚔️ Join the Guild

Enter the ranks of the Warrior Guild — a brotherhood of adventurers, mercenaries, and heroes bound by steel and purpose. Train your skills, master your weapons, and take on challenges that test your courage against monsters, bandits, and mythical dragons.

🐎 Ride and Fly

Tame powerful mounts to traverse the open world. Charge into battle atop a horse or soar across mountains and battlefields on the back of a pegasus.

🐉 Slay Dragons

Face colossal dragons in cinematic boss encounters. Each battle demands precision, timing, and bravery — every victory earns glory, loot, and renown within the Guild.

🌍 Explore and Progress

Discover hidden villages, ancient ruins, and wild frontiers. Level up your character, craft new gear, and unlock unique fighting styles as you grow from novice to champion.

Current Features

  • Third-person PvE combat

  • Mounts and flying mechanics

  • Dragon encounters and boss fights

Planned Features

  • Expanded world regions

  • Story-driven questlines

  • Weapon specialization trees

  • Mount breeding and customization

  • Cooperative multiplayer missions

  • Core progression systems (combat, leveling, and guild ranking)

Warrior Guild is currently in active development. Join early, shape the future of the game with your feedback, and become part of the Guild’s founding generation.
